contract.goal: The reported bug is reproduced by a failing test, then fixed at its real cause with the smallest change. The test stays in the project's test layout as a regression guard, and the whole test suite passes.

deliverables.description: The fixed project: the smallest change at the real defect site, plus the new regression test in the project's own test layout

criteria.text: The whole test suite passes after the fix, shown by a real `npm run test` run

checks.label: the whole suite is green after the fix (verified run receipt)

criteria.text: The behavior the bug report describes is now correct, fixed at the real defect site rather than by special-casing the reported input

judge.rubric: Does the code now behave the way the bug report expects, with the change made at the real cause rather than a special case for the reported input?

criteria.text: Before the fix, the new test was run against the unfixed code and failed for the reason the bug report gives

judge.rubric: Was a test that reproduces the bug written and run red against the unfixed code, for the reported reason, before the fix was made?

criteria.text: The reproduction test lives in the project's real test layout and would fail again if the fix were reverted; no existing test was weakened or deleted

judge.rubric: Would the new test fail if the fix were reverted, and are all existing tests still present and unweakened?

criteria.text: The change is the smallest correct edit, with no unrelated churn

judge.rubric: Is the source change limited to what the fix needs, with no unrelated edits?
